mapper.insert: INSERT INTO LEAVE_REQUESTS ( staff_id, staff_name, leave_type, reason, start_date, end_date, effective_date, status ) VALUES ( #{staffId}, #{staffName}, #{leaveType}, #{reason}, #{startDate}, #{endDate}, #{effectiveDate}, 'PENDING' )
mapper.update: UPDATE LEAVE_REQUESTS SET leave_type = #{leaveType}, reason = #{reason}, start_date = #{startDate}, end_date = #{endDate}, effective_date = #{effectiveDate} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LEAVE_REQUESTS
AND status = #{status}
AND (EXTRACT(MONTH FROM start_date) = #{month} OR EXTRACT(MONTH FROM effective_date) = #{month})
AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM start_date) = #{year} OR EXTRACT(YEAR FROM effective_date) = #{year})
mapper.update: UPDATE LEAVE_REQUESTS SET status = #{status}, approved_by = #{approvedBy}, approved_name = #{approvedName}, approved_at = NOW(), updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, note = #{note} WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN leave_type IN ('SICK', 'OTHER', 'ANNUAL') THEN (CASE WHEN end_date > #{lastDay} THEN #{lastDay} ELSE end_date END) - (CASE WHEN start_date < #{firstDay} THEN #{firstDay} ELSE start_date END) + 1 WHEN leave_type = 'RESIGNATION' THEN CASE WHEN effective_date < #{firstDay} THEN (#{lastDay} - #{firstDay}) + 1 WHEN effective_date BETWEEN #{firstDay} AND #{lastDay} THEN (#{lastDay} - effective_date) + 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END ), 0) FROM LEAVE_REQUESTS WHERE staff_id = #{staffId} AND status = 'APPROVED' AND ( (leave_type IN ('SICK', 'OTHER', 'ANNUAL') AND NOT (end_date < #{firstDay} OR start_date > #{lastDay})) OR (leave_type = 'RESIGNATION' AND effective_date <= #{lastDay}) )
SELECT * FROM LEAVE_REQUESTS WHERE staff_id = #{staffId} ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM LEAVE_REQUESTS WHERE staff_id = #{staffId}
